time_resampling: linear interpolation between the two native frames around each export instant

stages.calibration: RANSAC + soft-L1 Levenberg-Marquardt on the cached keypoint and line detections; Laplace covariance of the 8 homography parameters
stages.detection: foot points read from the input
stages.localization: inverse homography; delta-method covariance from the calibration, scaled by the Mondrian conformal quantile of each player's bin (metres per pixel at the feet, RANSAC inliers)
stages.health: none: calib_health is null; a frame abstains when its calibration failed
